title: 1638 Prairie gets the back of the house its map draws
items: The Gothic house at 1638 Prairie now has the shape the 1911 fire-insurance map gives it: the back of the house widens toward the north, and a two-storey wing juts out of the south side halfway back.
Small one-storey rooms with flat tin-style roofs wrap the back corner and sit along the north side, where the map draws them.
No picture shows these sides, so their windows, roofs and heights are a marked liberty.
